tagline: The long-standing Robot Framework web library, built on Selenium WebDriver.
comparedAgainst: Selenium 4, shown here through its Python API
scenario: Open a form, check the title, fill a field, submit and assert the response.
notes: Selenium waits explicitly — implicitly_wait, or an explicit wait per element.
Browser waits on every action, so there is nothing to configure per element.
Selenium drives a separate driver process per browser; Browser uses one Node process for all three engines.
SeleniumLibrary is a sibling project in the same ecosystem, and remains a sound choice for WebDriver-based setups.
